headline: IREN Reports Q4 FY2026 Earnings
summary: IREN reported Q4 FY2026 revenue of $137.2 million, missing estimates of $157.14 million by 12.7%. Net loss was $684 million, driven by non-cash mining exit impairments. AI Cloud revenue reached $70.5 million, accounting for 51.4% of total revenue, with annual recurring revenue (ARR) increasing from $500 million to $1 billion post-Microsoft deal. The company expects $4 billion ARR by December 2026. Capital expenditures for FY2027 are projected between $25 billion and $30 billion to support AI infrastructure buildout. Mining operations are set to be fully decommissioned by December 2026 as IREN completes its strategic pivot to AI infrastructure. ([investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/iris-energy-earnings?utm_source=openai))
why_it_matters: The shift towards AI Cloud services and the decommissioning of mining operations align with IREN's long-term strategy to focus on AI infrastructure, potentially enhancing its competitive position in the AI cloud market.

headline: Pony AI Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results: Total Revenues Up 68.8% YoY to US$36.2 mm with Robotaxi Services Revenue Up 691.2% to US$12.1 mm

why_it_matters: The strategic partnerships with major companies like Uber enhance Pony AI's market reach and credibility, supporting the long-term investment thesis centered on collaborative growth in the autonomous vehicle sector.
